description: Offer at a port far from the ship's route. Extraction is still a plain BUNKER_OFFER; deciding it isn't worth it is the calculation's job.
subject: Bunker offer - VLSFO at Genoa
body:
Good morning,

We can offer MV Aegean Star VLSFO at Genoa (ITGOA) at USD 520/mt, 500 mt, delivery ex-pipeline.

Offer valid until 2026-11-24 12:00 UTC.

Kind regards,
Ligurian Fuels S.p.A.
